2608.23047.title: Beyond Verdicts: A Graph-Based Analysis of Human and LLM Reasoning in Scientific Fact-Checking
2608.23047.paper_summary: Misinformation that cites legitimate papers can be especially harmful when it distorts what those studies actually report. While existing automatic fact-checking systems based on large language models (LLMs) can assess whether a model assigns an Incorrect verdict and can gen- erate explanations for that decision, they typi- cally do not indicate whether the model follows the same reasoning path as human experts or arrives at the verdict through a different but still valid path. In this work, we introduce a graph- based framework (typed reasoning graph) for comparing human and LLM reasoning paths in scientific fact-checking. Building on prior work on fallacious reasoning in biomedical misinformation, MISSCIPLUS (Glockner et al., 2025), we model each explanation as a rea- soning graph that links the false claim to the relevant study context, study findings, fallacy- supporting premises, and fallacy labels. This representation enables one-to-one alignment of human and LLM reasoning at the level of fallacy-specific sub-graphs. For non-human- aligned LLM paths, we validate grounding in the cited study, relevance to the claim, and suf- ficiency for the verdict. Using 84 false claims from MISSCIPLUS, we evaluate GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Qwen3-32B across prompt and evidence settings. Results show distinct perfor- mance dimensions: Qwen3-32B has the lowest verdict failure rate, GPT-5 the highest human alignment, and Claude Opus 4.7 weak verdict prediction but often valid reasoning in success- ful cases
2608.23047.paper_summary_zh: 錯誤資訊如果引用了合法的論文，當它扭曲了這些研究實際報告的內容時，尤其會造成傷害。雖然現有的基於大型語言模型（LLMs）的自動事實檢查系統可以評估模型是否給出了不正確的判斷，並能生成該決策的解釋，但它們通常不會指明模型是否遵循與人類專家相同的推理路徑，或是通過不同但仍然有效的路徑得出判斷。在這項工作中，我們介紹了一個基於圖形的框架（類型推理圖），用於比較人類和LLM在科學事實檢查中的推理路徑。基於先前在生物醫學錯誤資訊中對謬誤推理的研究，MISSCIPLUS（Glockner et al., 2025），我們將每個解釋建模為一個推理圖，將虛假聲明與相關的研究背景、研究結果、支持謬誤的前提和謬誤標籤聯繫起來。這種表示法使人類和LLM在特定謬誤子圖層面上實現一對一的對齊。對於非人類對齊的LLM路徑，我們驗證了其在引用研究中的基礎、與聲明的相關性以及對判斷的充分性。使用來自MISSCIPLUS的84個虛假聲明，我們評估了GPT-5、Claude Opus 4.7和Qwen3-32B在提示和證據設置下的表現。結果顯示出不同的性能維度：Qwen3-32B的判斷失敗率最低，GPT-5的人類對齊度最高，而Claude Opus 4.7的判斷預測較弱，但在成功案例中經常有有效的推理。
